label: TP
reason: User-controlled data from HTTP headers flows into the HTML response body without sanitization, confirming an XSS vulnerability. Additionally, java.util.Random is used for session token generation, constituting an insecure randomness issue (CWE-330).

evidence.note: Parameter 'param' is populated from HTTP header names, allowing user control over input.
Cookie name and value ('rememberMe') are concatenated directly into the response writer without HTML encoding.
Session token generated using java.util.Random instead of cryptographically secure random source.
